entities.summary: Nasry Juan Asfura Zablah, also known as Tito Asfura, is a Honduran politician and construction businessman serving as the president of Honduras since 2026. A member of the National Party of Honduras (PNH), he previously served as the mayor of Tegucigalpa from 2014 to 2022.
